name: fluent-mcp
description: MCP server for ServiceNow Fluent SDK commands and development resources.
long_description: Fluent MCP provides ServiceNow Fluent SDK command tools, API specifications, authoring instructions, code snippets, and development prompts over MCP.

tools.name: deploy_fluent_app
tools.description: Deploy a Fluent application to ServiceNow.

tools.name: explain_fluent_api
tools.description: Look up Fluent SDK API and guide documentation.

tools.name: fluent_transform
tools.description: Transform metadata into Fluent source code.

tools.name: get-api-spec
tools.description: Read a Fluent metadata API specification.

tools.name: get-snippet
tools.description: Read a Fluent metadata code snippet.

tools.name: init_fluent_app
tools.description: Initialize or convert a Fluent application.

tools.name: query_fluent_records
tools.description: Run a read-only ServiceNow Table REST query.

tools.name: sdk_info
tools.description: Read ServiceNow Fluent SDK version or help.

FLUENT_MCP_WORKING_DIR.title: Fluent project directory
FLUENT_MCP_WORKING_DIR.description: Absolute Fluent project path used when a tool call does not provide workingDirectory.

SN_INSTANCE_URL.title: ServiceNow instance URL
SN_INSTANCE_URL.description: Optional instance URL used for lazy authentication validation.

SN_AUTH_TYPE.title: ServiceNow authentication type
SN_AUTH_TYPE.description: Authentication method for lazy validation: basic or oauth.
